source_text: Recitatus est Iesu obitus — filius Nave centum decem annorum. Ille mortuus est; noster Iesus semper vivit. Mihi vivere Christus est. Qui peccant rursus crucifixunt Filium Dei. Mortuo Iesu Nave populus declinat.
pass_a_gloss: Recited is of-Jesus death — son of-Nun one-hundred ten of-years. That dead is; our Jesus always lives. To-me to-live Christ is. Who sin again crucify Son of-God. With-dead Jesus Nun people declines.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus son of Nun’s death is read — one hundred ten years >> Bible:Judges 2:8]]. That Jesus died; our Jesus always lives. [[For me to live is Christ >> Bible:Philippians 1:21]]. Those who fall away [[crucify the Son of God again >> Bible:Hebrews 6:6]]. When Nun’s son is dead, the people decline.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
